reasons.correctness: Endpoint, service, repository method and DTO match the interface. The service checks admin with the same key as updateTicketStatus and throws ValidationTranslatableException on from>to. Every status is filled via EnumMap. Hidden tests pass 5/5.
reasons.convention_fit: The endpoint has @PreAuthorize and is covered by the class-level @RateLimit. The new i18n key is in both property files and the response is a DtoOut. The tests extend the existing SupportTicketServiceUnitTest instead of adding a new *UnitTest class.
reasons.design_fit: Logic sits in the service and the query in a derived repository method. The controller copies the neighbours' SecurityContextHolder auth/GDPR boilerplate, which duplicates the service-side permission check. Repository Javadoc calls the Between end exclusive, but JPA Between is inclusive.
reasons.test_quality: Three Mockito tests cover the non-admin denial, the from>to rejection with its message key, and the per-status counts plus total with exact start/end stubs. No Spring context. They were added to an existing class, and there is no single-day or from==to case.
reasons.graph_use: One graph query listed the support/ticket files up front. Navigation then relied on failed reads, globs and greps. No graph lookup of an existing example or of the dependents before editing.
